<Task xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task" version="1.2">
  <RegistrationInfo>
    <Description>Run saved Companion schedules while this user is signed in. No browser is opened.</Description>
    <URI>\SyntheticSchedule</URI>
  </RegistrationInfo>
  <Principals>
    <Principal id="Author">
      <UserId>S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001</UserId>
      <LogonType>InteractiveToken</LogonType>
    </Principal>
  </Principals>
  <Settings>
    <DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>
    <StopIfGoingOnBatteries>false</StopIfGoingOnBatteries>
    <ExecutionTimeLimit>PT6H</ExecutionTimeLimit>
    <MultipleInstancesPolicy>IgnoreNew</MultipleInstancesPolicy>
    <StartWhenAvailable>true</StartWhenAvailable>
    <RunOnlyIfNetworkAvailable>true</RunOnlyIfNetworkAvailable>
    <IdleSettings>
      <StopOnIdleEnd>true</StopOnIdleEnd>
      <RestartOnIdle>false</RestartOnIdle>
    </IdleSettings>
  </Settings>
  <Triggers>
    <CalendarTrigger>
      <StartBoundary>2027-11-21T00:00:00</StartBoundary>
      <Repetition>
        <Interval>PT1H</Interval>
        <Duration>P1D</Duration>
      </Repetition>
      <ScheduleByDay>
        <DaysInterval>1</DaysInterval>
      </ScheduleByDay>
    </CalendarTrigger>
  </Triggers>
  <Actions Context="Author">
    <Exec>
      <Command>C:\Synthetic\Program\runtime\pythonw.exe</Command>
      <Arguments>C:\Synthetic\Program\app\tools\run_scheduled.py --data-dir C:\Synthetic\data</Arguments>
      <WorkingDirectory>C:\Synthetic\Program\app</WorkingDirectory>
    </Exec>
  </Actions>
</Task>
